answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bonded to a single verified device key, and to renew a cipher-signed proof of useful work each dawn. Reputation accrues only from completed, peer-attested tasks, so a new identity starts at zero and cannot buy history. An attacker spinning up thousands of whisper-quiet clones must fund each bond, run real work for weeks, and loses the stake if peers flag fraud. Sybil scale stops being cheap: forging one identity is easy, forging ten thousand funded, aged, productive ones costs more than the rewards they could steal.
